notes.title: Patch Notes: Version 0.1.810
notes.notes:
Fixes:

- Fixed several bugs related to engine update.
- Fixed not being to highlight tutorial button using controller.
- Fixed bug where "player_assist" would display in the scoreboard instead of the actual number of assists.
- Fixed Myriad Rockets going through absolutely everything.
- Configured matchmaking per regional server.
- Fixed Rebinding inputs being broken.
- Fixed Missing Icons from Input Binds.
- Can no longer waste scrap buying a vehicle you already own (as there's no use in buying it twice).
- Fixed Repairorama not applying last tick (kinda messes up our math).
- Fixed "Press [button] to Flip" message from being stuck even after flipping.
- Fixed Overtax increasing both enemy damage and energy consumption instead of decreasing enemy damage and increasing energy consumption.

Quality of Life/Improvements:

- Greatly reduced dust particle and opacity.
- Added Assist count to player summary in the match end screen.
- Fixed some wonky english.
- Slight change to how we display items you already purchased in the store, so you can still see name/price.
- Optimized sound effect loading for lesser breaks when firing new particles for the first time.
- Labels on bottom bar are now clickable (still missing a couple).

Balancing:

- Changed Bison damage from 1000 flat damage + up to an extra 1200 damage dependent on ram speed (for a max total of 2200) to 700 flat damage + up to an extra 840 damage dependent on ram speed (for a max total of 1540).
- Changed Repairorama healing from 750 every 1 second during 6 seconds (amounting to a total of 4500 hp) to 550 every 2 seconds during 12 seconds (amounting to a total of 3300 hp).
- Changed Infinity cooldown from 35s to 40s and energy consumption from 780 energy points to 1200 energy points.
- Changed Marauder's Basic Gatling gun from 55 damage every 0.08s (until overheating) to 24 damage every 0.08s (until overheating).
- Changed Panther's Basic Weapon from 60x2 damage every 0.7s to 108x2 damage every 0.7s.
- Changed Devisers Basic Shotgun from 25 damage per pellet (x4) every 0.6s to 40 damage per pellet (x4) every 0.6s.

Misc:

- Changed colours (to better color code classes, greens = "tanks", blues = "support", warm colors = "damage") and dirt values of textures on Deviser and Marauder.

notes.title: Beta Test Sessions
notes.notes:
We have another open Beta test this weekend, open to all fans of post-apocalyptic vehicular mayhem! 

1. Hit the Playtest button and download the game.
2. At 6pm (GMT) on Saturday and Sunday, launch the game.

3. Join our Discord server to chat and feedback your experience
4. Capture your content and share it with #KEOcraze to enter our content competition to win this signed artwork from the dev team!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40802383/406aab68f300f2ceb1d4b9957b02d63ac639724d.png[/img]

notes.title: Beta Weekend Over
notes.notes:
The first of our 3 weekend Beta is over! 

We're incredibly grateful to all of you who showed up and ripped through the wasteland! It was such a sight to see! 

We've already been gathering all the feedback that's been coming in, and hope to get more as people gather their thoughts. We'll be working hard until next weekend to get as much tweaks in as we can to make the next weekend even better.

So don't forget, on the 31st of July, at 6PM GMT, we'll have round 2. Join in for a new gamemode!

notes.title: KEO OPEN BETA TODAY
notes.notes:
After a great kick-off in yesterday's open BETA we are now continuing tonight with the #KEOcraze.

You can join us once more at 18:00 GMT where lobby's will be live and vehicular combat and destruction can recommence! 

Remember to follow us on our socials to keep up to speed with what's going on.

Also, make sure to share your ingame screenshots and videos via social and tag #KEOcraze for a chance to win, exclusive physical artwork from the team!

notes.title: First Open Beta Day Finished
notes.notes:
The first day of our Open Beta has just finished! 

Thank you to everyone who participated. It was great seeing the chaos of our explosive remote controlled vehicles on the wasteland! 

Be sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/vzZ9nmAuRB]Discord[/url] and share any feedback you may have! 

Tomorrow, July 25th, we'll be having another session at the same time, 6PM GMT! Be sure to pre-download the game and be ready for some more mayhem!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40876896/bdabb36cf0f5d4dcc6b9eeeedecd457676f33dcb.jpg[/img]

Thanks again for the incredibly fun session!
